sources: NASA Human Research Program (HRP) - Five Hazards of Human Spaceflight
Canadian Space Agency (CSA) - Space Radiation & Autonomous Healthcare

spacecraft.label: Spacecraft Transit
spacecraft.description: Deep-space transit vehicle with elevated cosmic/solar radiation, 0g cephalad fluid shift, and significant communication latency.

station.label: Space Station (ISS / Gateway)
station.description: Orbital habitat with near-real-time ground contact, musculoskeletal unloading, and closed-loop CO2 scrubbing.

rover.label: Lunar / Mars Rover (EVA)
rover.description: Pressurized rover or EVA sortie with elevated cardiovascular workload, suit thermal rise, and unshielded solar radiation risk.

base.label: Planetary Base
base.description: Long-duration surface base with partial gravity, lunar/Martian regolith dust irritation risk, and prolonged isolation.

body_zones.label: Heart & Vessels
body_zones.organ_function: Maintains systemic perfusion and blood pressure regulation under altered gravity.
body_zones.default_summary: Resting HR and BP within microgravity baseline.
body_zones.space_hazard: Gravity Fields (cephalad fluid shift) & Hostile Closed Environments (CO2 load)
body_zones.why_exam_needed: Microgravity shifts fluid toward the thorax and head, shrinking plasma volume and risking orthostatic intolerance.
body_zones.self_exam_guide: Sit still for 3 minutes, wrap cuff at heart level, press Measure, and log systolic/diastolic values.

body_zones.label: Lungs / Airway
body_zones.organ_function: Gas exchange (O2 intake and CO2 clearance) inside pressurized spacecraft/habitat atmosphere.
body_zones.default_summary: Airway and cabin CO2 response remain stable.
body_zones.space_hazard: Hostile Closed Environments (CO2 scrubber drift, airborne particulates)
body_zones.why_exam_needed: Elevated cabin CO2 or pulmonary fluid shift can cause headaches, tachypnea, and B-line artifacts on lung ultrasound.
body_zones.self_exam_guide: Check cabin CO2 readout, perform a 4-zone anterior chest ultrasound sweep if short of breath, and log resting HR.

body_zones.label: Bones & Spine
body_zones.organ_function: Structural support, calcium homeostasis, and intervertebral spacing.
body_zones.default_summary: ARED resistive countermeasures on track with no acute metabolic strain.
body_zones.space_hazard: Gravity Fields (bone mineral density loss and spinal elongation in 0g)
body_zones.why_exam_needed: Astronauts lose 1-1.5% bone mineral density per month in microgravity without resistive exercise and metabolic stability.
body_zones.self_exam_guide: Complete daily 30-min ARED resistive routine, note lower back tension, and maintain morning glucose checks.

body_zones.label: Kidneys / Fluid
body_zones.organ_function: Fluid balance, electrolyte filtration, and renal stone risk prevention.
body_zones.default_summary: Hydration and metabolic glucose indicators remain balanced.
body_zones.space_hazard: Gravity Fields (bone calcium mobilization increasing renal stone risk) & Isolation
body_zones.why_exam_needed: Bone resorption releases calcium into urine while reduced thirst cues in space elevate kidney stone and dehydration risk.
body_zones.self_exam_guide: Track 2.5 L daily fluid intake, check fasting glucose, and run bladder/kidney ultrasound if flank discomfort occurs.

body_zones.label: Skin
body_zones.organ_function: Primary barrier against dry cabin air, microbes, and ionizing radiation.
body_zones.default_summary: No erythema flare or radiation-associated skin irritation flagged.
body_zones.space_hazard: Hostile Closed Environments (low humidity / microbiome) & Space Radiation
body_zones.why_exam_needed: Skin rashes, slow wound healing, and dryness are among the most frequent in-flight medical complaints.
body_zones.self_exam_guide: Capture a well-lit close-up photo of any rash or irritation using the Vision Camera in Skin/Eye mode.

body_zones.label: Immune System
body_zones.organ_function: Cellular defense and inflammation regulation under cosmic radiation and stress.
body_zones.default_summary: Body temperature and cumulative radiation dose remain within nominal bounds.
body_zones.space_hazard: Space Radiation (CSA dosimetry) & Isolation Stress (immune dysregulation)
body_zones.why_exam_needed: Cosmic radiation and stress alter leukocyte activity and can reactivate latent viruses or raise infection risk.
body_zones.self_exam_guide: Verify personal CSA radiation dosimeter reading, measure oral temperature, and log malaise or swollen nodes.

body_zones.label: Brain / Cognition
body_zones.organ_function: Executive alertness, circadian synchronization, and emotional resilience.
body_zones.default_summary: Sleep architecture and behavioral mood state are nominal.
body_zones.space_hazard: Isolation and Confinement (circadian misalignment & cognitive fatigue)
body_zones.why_exam_needed: 16 sunrises/day or non-24h Martian sols erode sleep quality, raising operational error and behavioral health risk.
body_zones.self_exam_guide: Log sleep hours upon waking, rate mood 1-10 honestly, and use blue-enriched light during wake shift.

body_zones.label: Eyes (SANS)
body_zones.organ_function: Ocular acuity, optic nerve head integrity, and tear-film comfort.
body_zones.default_summary: No fluid-shift or circadian strain warning affecting ocular health.
body_zones.space_hazard: Gravity Fields (Spaceflight Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome - SANS) & Closed Air
body_zones.why_exam_needed: Cephalad fluid shift elevates intracranial pressure against the optic nerve and flattens the globe over long flights.
body_zones.self_exam_guide: Capture an eye close-up photo if redness or visual blur occurs, check blood pressure, and run Amsler grid self-test.
